FN-RO4PYY-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 108
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/30/2023
Senate Bill 108 as introduced increases the competitive bidding floor for certain local and
education agencies from $15,000, under current law, to $30,000, as well as increasing other
threshold dollar amounts for which competitive bidding is required. In addition, it authorizes
those dollar amounts to be further increased based on increases in Consumer Price Index. This
bill could increase or decrease the purchase price of goods and services procured by these
entities, depending on the difference in (1) the cost of products procured under the provisions of
this bill and (2) the cost otherwise obtained under current law.
